detailed_description: Currency Converter is a comprehensive tool that helps you convert between 45+ world currencies instantly. Support for major currencies like USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY, as well as Asian, European, American, and Middle Eastern currencies. Features include quick swap between currencies, preset amount buttons, and detailed exchange rate information.
usage_steps: Enter the amount you want to convert
Select the source currency from the dropdown
Select the target currency from the dropdown
Use the swap button to reverse the conversion
Click preset amounts for quick calculations
usage_examples: Convert USD to EUR for travel planning
Calculate exchange rates for international purchases
Compare currency values across different countries
